failure_modes.label: Brake overheat / dragging brake

hypotheses.cause: Brake metering valve slow to release, keeping pressure on the brake
Air in the brake lines causing uneven or dragging application
Worn brake assembly replaced without finding the root cause

steps: Check brake wear pins and record measurements.
Inspect brake metering valve for slow release; perform release test.
Bleed brake system and check for air.
Inspect wheel fuse plugs and tire condition.
Perform taxi test and record brake temperatures.

procedures.snippet: Covers brake inspection, wear checks, bleeding and troubleshooting of dragging or overheating brakes.
Acceptable methods for inspecting and repairing aircraft systems and components, including landing gear and brakes.

failure_modes.label: Hydraulic pump leak

hypotheses.cause: Pump shaft seal wear allowing case drain leakage
Fitting or B-nut incorrectly torqued after previous repair

steps: Clean area and run leak check to find the exact leak point.
Inspect case drain filter for metal or debris.
Check fittings and B-nuts for correct torque.
Replace seals or pump as required.
Perform system pressure and leak check.

procedures.section: Chapter 12 — Hydraulic and Pneumatic Power Systems
procedures.snippet: Covers hydraulic pumps, seals, fittings, filters and troubleshooting of leaks and low pressure.
Acceptable methods for inspection and repair of hydraulic system components and lines.

failure_modes.label: Cabin pressure controller fault

hypotheses.cause: Chafed or loose wiring at the controller connector (intermittent fault)
Controller replaced but wiring fault not found, so the fault returned
Software or BITE reset only clearing the symptom

steps: Read BITE history from the controller.
Inspect connector and wiring behind the mounting bracket for chafing.
Repair wiring and secure with clamps.
Replace controller only if wiring is good.
Perform pressurization system test.

procedures.snippet: Covers pressurization controllers, outflow valves and troubleshooting pressurization faults.
Acceptable methods for inspecting wire bundles, chafing protection, clamping and splicing.

failure_modes.label: Generator (IDG) low oil pressure

hypotheses.cause: Internal IDG oil leak or seal failure
Oil serviced without finding the leak source

steps: Check IDG oil level and filter differential pressure indicator.
Inspect for external leaks at seals and lines.
Check oil cooler and lines.
Replace IDG if internal leak suspected.
Run generator ops check.

procedures.snippet: Covers aircraft generators, constant speed drives and troubleshooting generator faults.

failure_modes.label: Fuel quantity indication fault

hypotheses.cause: Moisture or corrosion at the fuel probe connector
Damaged harness between probe and wing root

steps: Check indication on ground with known fuel load.
Inspect probe connectors for moisture and corrosion.
Check harness continuity and insulation resistance.
Clean, reseal or replace harness section.
Verify indication.

procedures.snippet: Covers fuel quantity indicating systems, probes and troubleshooting.
Acceptable methods for connector inspection, moisture protection and wire repair.
